subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should `agent:bootstrap` hook handlers remain one uninterrupted ordered mutation chain, or may unrelated event-loop work run between handlers?
rationale: The patch preserves handler order but changes atomicity around a shared bootstrap operation, and repository history or current tests do not define whether plugins may rely on uninterrupted execution.

options.title: Keep handler chain atomic
options.body: Remove `yieldBetweenHandlers` from bootstrap dispatch while retaining the async file and glob fixes plus timing diagnostics.

options.title: Approve cooperative interleaving
options.body: Keep the yields and add owner-approved contract documentation plus focused reentrancy coverage demonstrating the allowed observable behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep handler chain atomic
recommendation.body: Remove `yieldBetweenHandlers` from bootstrap dispatch while retaining the async file and glob fixes plus timing diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced the bootstrap hook and has the strongest repeated history on the hook contract and bootstrap-helper surfaces.
